author: Mark Atwood
text:
Scope correction: Convention B is NOT a metadata-server-specific divergence. The same to_string().as_str() pattern lives at the equivalent line in 5 cookie-cut siblings:

- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:569-574, 614-619
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:514-519, 559-564
- crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/memory.rs:505-510, 547-552  (this finding's site)
- crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:403-408, 448-453
- crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs:517-522, 562-567

The canonical jmap-mail-server uses Convention A everywhere — meaning the 5 siblings ALL diverged from the canonical at the same place during the original cookie-cut. Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule: this is a propagation regression, not a metadata-server bug. Fix in one pass across all 5 siblings, no canonical change needed (mail-server is already correct).

Tracking the cross-sibling fix here is fine if the bead is treated as the gate for all 5. Alternatively split into 5 sibling beads with this one as parent — but for a P3 chore-priority alloc tidy, that's overhead.
